_doc: min_ms is the MINIMUM ever observed on this host and only ratchets DOWN; contention can only add time. max_ratio is a MEASURED tolerance and its absence FAILS CLOSED (CR-68) — never type it. ⛔ AND NOTHING WRITES IT: --calibrate does setdefault(max_ratio, None), so this key is permanently null and the precondition is permanently advisory (warn-and-run). Arming it requires a derivation procedure that does not exist yet — an operator design decision, measured 2026-09-24. probe_version 1 was a SINGLE-THREADED loop and moved only 4% across a 7x change in load, so its numbers are not comparable to v2 (parallel) and were cleared rather than carried forward.
